name: Extreme Spy! Sola to Piyo-chan
original_name: エクストリーム・スパイ！ソラとピヨちゃん
source:
Sola, a 15-year-old girl, is from the countryside of Hokkaido. Unable to endure her cold adoptive father and adoptive mother, she came to Tokyo to find a part-time job to become independent.

In there, Sola met Piyo-chan, an AI for mobile phones. He is the representative of a detective agency and is currently looking for a part-time job in the office.

Despite that, he has an irritational and sloppy personality. His specialty is illegal hacking.
Sola always had a bad time, as she was constantly pushed around by him
This is a series of stories that depict the growth of 2 people while getting themselves involved in many troubles.

[Translated from the [url=http://fuwafuwaso.main.jp/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
Sola，一名15岁的女孩，来自北海道的乡村。由于无法忍受养父和养母的冷漠，她来到东京寻找一份兼职工作以实现独立。

在那里，Sola遇到了手机AI Piyo-chan。他是一家侦探社的代表，目前正在办公室寻找一份兼职工作。

尽管如此，他的性格却很暴躁、草率。他的专长是非法黑客攻击。
索拉总是过得很不好，因为她总是被他摆布
这是一个讲述两个人在经历许多麻烦的同时成长的故事。

[翻译自[url=http://fuwafuwaso.main.jp/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
